risk_if_not_implemented: Without Physically Disable or Remove Capabilities, unauthorized individuals may gain physical access to facilities and equipment, enabling theft, tampering, damage or safety incidents. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), System / Data Compromise (Non-Technical Vector) (R-BC-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Physical Crime (MT-5), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Least Functionality
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to configure Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) to provide only essential capabilities by specifically prohibiting or restricting the use of ports, protocols, and/or services.
compensating_control_1.justification: Least Functionality (CFG-03) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Port & Input / Output (I/O) Device Access (CFG-05.1) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Least Privilege
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize the concept of least privilege, allowing only authorized access to processes necessary to accomplish assigned tasks in accordance with organizational business functions.
compensating_control_2.justification: Least Privilege (IAC-30) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Port & Input / Output (I/O) Device Access (CFG-05.1) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
